name: early_return_in_if_wrong
source:
Module m.
Rule r given x as Int, produce Int:
  If x greater than 700
    Return "high".
  Return 0.

name: nested_if_wrong
source:
Module m.
Rule r given x as Int, produce Int:
  If x greater than 700
    If x greater than 900
      Return "very".
    Return 1.
  Return 0.

name: plain_wrong
source:
Module m.
Rule r given x as Int, produce Int:
  Return "high".

name: final_wrong
source:
Module m.
Rule r given x as Int, produce Int:
  If x greater than 700
    Return 1.
  Return "low".

name: early_return_ok
source:
Module m.
Rule r given x as Int, produce Int:
  If x greater than 700
    Return 1.
  Return 0.

name: widen_decimal_early
source:
Module m.
Rule r given x as Int, produce Decimal:
  If x greater than 700
    Return 1.
  Return x.

name: widen_float
source:
Module m.
Rule r given x as Int, produce Float:
  Return 1.

name: unknown_field_early
source:
Module m.
Define Ab has score, label.
Rule r given a as Ab, produce Int:
  If a.score greater than 700
    Return a.label.
  Return 0.
